## VS Evolution Helper (BepInEx) 1.9.7

### Highlights
- **Character Selection tooltips** with flavor text, starting weapon + evolution icons, outfits, stats
- Tooltip sits **near the character** (original placement)
- **Click-through** — you can still select the character under the tooltip
- Stage Guide controller support, config toggles, map/grimoire/level-up tooltips (prior releases)

### Install
1. **BepInEx 6 IL2CPP** — [builds.bepinex.dev](https://builds.bepinex.dev/projects/bepinex_be) (Unity.IL2CPP Windows)
2. Extract so you get `BepInEx/plugins/VSEvolutionHelper/VSEvolutionHelper.dll`
3. Close the game before updating the DLL
